task: Extend git remote repo-name extraction to strip Bitbucket Server/DC HTTPS /scm/ segment and normalise legacy Azure DevOps (visualstudio.com, vs-ssh) remotes to org/Project/repo.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is the existing Azure host-dispatch in parseGitRemoteUrl; it does not cover path-based /scm/ stripping (self-hosted arbitrary hosts, risk of mis-stripping a group named scm) or org derivation from the visualstudio.com hostname. No security-sensitive surface (credentials stay outside capture groups). Existing it.each test template covers the edge-case table pattern, so no extra bump.
Examples are concrete, but scope of scm stripping, case sensitivity of DefaultCollection/host and port handling are open decisions.
